subject.why: The golden mirror, stand, blue glass, and rose detail match the brief.

category.why: Stone paving is ill-suited to a vanity mirror; a tabletop is required.

clean.why: Free of text, UI elements, characters, and frames.

framing.why: Centred with ample margins on all sides.

colour.why: The purple background is too dark and cool rather than bright and warm.

detail.why: Clean shapes with no busy textures or micro-details.

style.why: Rendered with smooth, chunky volumes and a satin sheen matching the style.

fix: Place the mirror on a smooth wooden tabletop and brighten the background to a warm, saturated hue.
